items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I can only go back as far as my grandfather, Grandpa Jesse

ctx.x: In this little town. He had most of the, about half of the street in this little town. But, the barber shop was in Atlanta.
Where did he get the groceries from? Did he grow his own groceries? Did he stock his store?
